```{r}
DC <- readRDS("./seurat_list_with_CPM_log1p.rds")
```

```{r}
target_clusters <- as.character(0:86)
```

```{r}
# 创建一个空数据框存储结果
results <- data.frame(
    Cluster = character(),
    MaxCorrelation = numeric(),
    MaxDC = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (cluster in target_clusters) {
    print(paste("Processing cluster:", cluster))
    
    # 初始化最大值和对应的DC
    maximum <- -99999
    max_dc <- NULL
    
    # 获取当前 cluster 的所有 DC 数据列和 Age 列
    age_data <- DC[[cluster]]@meta.data$Age
    for (dc_num in 1:20) {
        # 动态访问列名
        dc_data <- DC[[cluster]]@meta.data[[paste0("DC", dc_num)]]
        
        # 计算相关性
        cor_value <- cor(age_data, dc_data)
        
        # 更新最大值和对应的 DC
        if (cor_value > maximum) {
            maximum <- cor_value
            max_dc <- paste0("DC", dc_num)
        }
    }
    
    # 保存结果到数据框
    results <- rbind(
        results,
        data.frame(
            Cluster = cluster,
            MaxCorrelation = maximum,
            MaxDC = max_dc,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    )
}

# 打印最终结果
print(results)

# 保存结果到 CSV 文件
write.csv(results, file = "../cluster_max_correlation_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print("Results saved to cluster_max_correlation_results.csv")
```
